profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I've always had an analytical mind and a passion for coming up with creative ideas. When confronted with a new subject, I learn best by understanding the roots of it - why things are the way they are!
So studying at Queen's University, it was natural to major in Physics and Statistics. Aside from the technical knowledge obtained through an education in Physics, I really learned how to think: how to break down complex subjects into fundamentals understanding why things are done in certain ways. I practiced drawing conclusions- starting with what we know to be true and expanding my knowledge using deductive reasoning. 

I was introduced to computing when I wrote a python script to simulate the chaotic behavior of fluid flows. I instantly realized what a powerful skill it was. In physics computing is the key to understanding long term behaviors of systems, but more importantly it was also the power to bring ideas to life - the ability to turn your ideas into tangible products.
 
Since then I’ve written code for many projects, from scripts analyzing the structural integrity, to full stack application development and task automation.

I have a passion for working on creative ideas that have a large potential of improving an industry or world at large. Working on exciting projects gives me the motivation to excel and gives my life meaning. 

My specialities include implementing responsive design principles, problem solving, Android application development and large data analysis. I am proficient in Java, Python, HTML, C#, SQL, Matlab, Git, Bash.

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
· Managed 5 engineers to design and implement a real-time spawning system for in game objects using Redis and Kuber- netes reducing latency by 1/5 to 150ms
· Designed, Implemented, and maintained CI/CD pipeline with Circle CI, BASH on Kubernetes allowing more than 20 deployments daily
· Implemented Kubernetes horizontal pod scaling based on metrics using Prometheus to reduce the spawn latency by 33%
· Implemented 99.95% reliable game notification service using Kafka and Redis

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Managed 4 engineers to Develop Android native apps for fitness trainers in Java, MySQL and Firebase acquiring 10k daily active users
· Extended the REST API test coverage by writing and deploying integration tests in a CI/CD flow using AWS and BASH
· Developed the primary web app using Typescript, React.js, Vue.js, Node.js and Docker

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant  - Ingenuity Labs - Image Analysis and AI for Structural Integrity
positions.description:
· Developed Java REST API using Spring, CV and MySQL to determine the stability of structures under stress
· Performed a regression analysis of structure stability using Tensorflow, Python and Numpy on AWS achieving 95%
accuracy within 2σ
· Built the primary web application using Django and Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Developed the front end of the primary web application using React js and Typescript and Node.js
· Developed and reduced bias of multivariate machine learning algorithms on AWS to determine the probability of drug
impairment based on sensor data
· Created python scripts to filter out the redundant visual data in the user’s eye movement by 72% before training models
